scope: Read-only exact dma5 archive review for the v1 native lower-bound and accepted/processed backlog fixes. Only this JSON was written. v0 tree, ZIP, archived RTL and tests were not changed; no hardware, EDA or cloud execution.
preconditions: Exact native fixed-mode/gamma-off build identity and1920x1080 dimensions are bound to the run.
Known binary decoded PGSTAT02 fields, matching125MHz manifest and an externally attested uninterrupted common-reset epoch.
Steady healthy snapshots: no logical failed flag, no static snapshot flag, no reset-release transient. All adjacent snapshot tick intervals are positive and shorter than2^32 core edges.
Request identity, sequence, tuple consistency and source-ID ordering checks remain required. These invariants do not themselves prove reset continuity or loaded firmware.

backlog_definitions.interval_rule: dA-dC == P2-P1, with dA=(A2-A1) mod M and dC=(C2-C1) mod M; the subtraction/equality here is ordinary signed integer arithmetic, not another modulo operation.

backlog_source_proof.fact: core_source_valid=dma_valid&&complete_metadata&&!failed; dma_ready=core_source_ready&&complete_metadata&&!failed. Thus DMA source_pop=dma_valid&&dma_ready is exactly the bank's core_source_valid&&core_source_ready, with the same pre-edge predicate. accepted_frames is directly exported.
The same src_valid/src_ready connects input_link and bank. captured is accepted_frames, processed is completed_frames, and processing is passed directly to the same core-domain stats snapshot.
Exactly that source_pop increments A once. Completion enqueue, grant reservation and capture/drop events do not increment A.
Bank acceptance requires !processing and sets P1. A successful completion requires old P1 and sets P0 while incrementing C. Acceptance and successful completion therefore cannot occur together.

Reset establishes A=C=0,P0. Every legal acceptance changes(A-C,P) from(0,0) to(1,1); every successful completion changes(1,1) to(0,0); all other healthy transitions leave the relation intact. This induction holds through modulo32 counter wrap. BANK lines94/99 and DMA lines96/104 are the respective reset assignments.
A,C and P are sampled atomically before the edge's NBA. A request coincident with acceptance/completion sees the old coherent triple, not a mixture of old count and new processing flag.

interval_reasoning.why_signed_exact_equality: The abstract unbounded event counts satisfy A_true-C_true=P. Over a bounded window each individual count advances fewer thanM times, so the modulo deltas recover their actual increments. Subtracting gives dA-dC=P2-P1 exactly, including-1 when an old in-flight frame completes with no new acceptance.
interval_reasoning.event_delta_guard: Retain0<=dA<=dt and0<=dC<=dt from the at-most-one increment per core edge. This is an interval event bound, not an unsigned absolute counter ratio or a claim that capture and processing counts must be equal.
interval_reasoning.point_check_not_sufficient_alone: Modulo endpoint backlog checks can miss a fabricated large interval delta that aliases-1 or1. Also apply the exact signed interval rule and the event-count bounds.
allowed_examples: P1->0 with dA0,dC1: an old in-flight frame completes. Do not require dC<=dA for every window.
P0->1 with dA1,dC0: a new frame starts but is still processing at the end.
P unchanged with dA=dC: any number of complete serial transactions can occur.
A wraps fromFFFFFFFF to0 while C remainsFFFFFFFF: P0->1 and modulo backlog1 are valid. Do not compare unsigned A>=C directly.
interval_reasoning.queue_boundary: Complete source descriptors still queued or being captured are not included in A. A waiting descriptor can make source_wait flag1 while P0 and A=C; there is no extra descriptor-queue term in this identity.

granted_reject.meaning: A bad already-granted completion increments dropped and possibly overflow, without a source_pop acceptance. It does not add an unprocessed accepted frame to A-C.

no_grant.meaning: The first DE in an input window may fail to begin capture and increments no_grant. This never creates A and is not exported by lightweight PGSTAT02.

drop_and_no_grant_are_separate.allowed_coincidence: A descriptor pop can occur on the same core edge as a different active capture's rejected completion. Both A and dropped can increment independently. Subtracting dropped from A-C would make a correct stream fail.
drop_and_no_grant_are_separate.host_policy: Do not add/subtract dropped or no-grant to repair backlog. Positive dropped can be a handled input-quality event with no logical pipeline failure; report it independently. A-C is not a count of all physical arrivals or all queued captures.

reset_sr_boundary.release: System cr and DMA sr use the same core/sys clock and same raw pipeline reset, each with a two-flop release chain. Bank/stats use cr; DMA counters and source_valid stay zero during !sr. The ideal exact RTL releases these chains together after an asserted common reset.
reset_sr_boundary.metadata_gate: The bank cannot consume a DMA descriptor while DMA source_valid is cleared; engine readiness also prevents acceptance during bank/core reset release. A legal steady, completed-frame-valid PGSTAT02 snapshot therefore has no ordinary sr startup exception to the invariant.
reset_sr_boundary.asynchronous_assertion_caveat: DMA A resets asynchronously on raw reset while BANK C/P reset synchronously at the next core edge after cr is pulled low. Between raw assertion and that edge, arbitrary internal signals need not satisfy A-C=P. This is a reset transient, not an uninterrupted healthy measurement window; the stats path is reset and cannot establish a valid new-epoch measurement there.
reset_sr_boundary.host_boundary: Reject/segregate any reset-crossing capture. Do not excuse a bad steady snapshot as a routine one-cycle sr offset. Conversely, do not use this source proof to assert invariant equality at arbitrary asynchronous reset instants or to prove that no reset occurred between otherwise plausible snapshots.

evidence.fact: The actual system instantiates WIDTH1920,HEIGHT1080 on the core clock.
A frame enters SCAN; at most one coordinate can be accepted per core edge. Index increments once for each accepted coordinate, and the engine cannot enter DRAIN until the Nth coordinate.
Success/done occurs only later in DRAIN upon writer_done; no frame can complete early merely because its mapped pixels are black or out of bounds.
The measured interval begins at bank source acceptance, includes engine startup/scan/writer drain and ends at bank success. It is at leastN edges; actual extra edges need not be hardcoded.

native_N_edge_lower_bound.rule: For a valid last tuple whose legacy duration is independently proven not to wrap, require raw+1>=N. This rejects raw0 being presented as a one-edge/8ns native frame.
native_N_edge_lower_bound.proof_order: Do not first reject every raw+1<N. Establish the unwrapped duration or its impossibility bound before applying the native duration lower bound.
no_wrap_cases: If snapshot core_tick<M in the same reset origin, the actual frame duration is belowM and at most core_tick. candidate>core_tick is a contradiction and should be rejected; otherwise the duration is proven and must be>=N.

If an adjacent healthy interval has0<dt<M and dC>=2, single-engine serialization places the last completed frame's start and finish inside this interval. candidate>dt is a contradiction; otherwise duration is proven belowM and must be>=N.
A previously proven identical completion tuple can retain its proof within the same uninterrupted epoch.
native_N_edge_lower_bound.unproven_case: At core_tick>=M with dC0/1 and no prior proof for that tuple, the last frame may have started before the window. A small legacy residue can be legitimate after wrap. Preserve raw and raw+1 candidate, mark no_wrap_unproven, and omit absolute duration/seconds; do not misclassify it as a one-cycle native frame.
native_N_edge_lower_bound.whole_frame_watchdog: TIMEOUT_BITS26 is passed to transaction-level components; the engine/bank do not expose a global duration-overflow flag or a proof that the sum of many bounded waits is belowM. Do not infer perpetual no-wrap from the local DDR watchdog alone.

conservative_processed_event_bound.rule: dC <= floor(dt/N)+1, for0<dt<M in the same healthy epoch and this exact single-engine architecture.
conservative_processed_event_bound.proof: Consecutive successful full-frame completions are separated by at leastN accepted-coordinate work edges, and full engine frames do not overlap. The first completion counted after the first snapshot may belong to a frame already running. That one boundary completion is allowed; every additional completion requires another serial native frame.
conservative_processed_event_bound.conservatism: The floor-plus-one formula is deliberately loose at exact multiples and does not rely on the earliest possible first completion phase. Tighter phase/overhead limits are unnecessary for this narrow repair.
conservative_processed_event_bound.independent_of_legacy_wrap: This bound uses real frame work and the processed event counter, not the last_cycles residue. It remains applicable when the last sample is no_wrap_unproven.
conservative_processed_event_bound.not_a_blind_ratio: Do not require dC/dt<=1/N without the boundary allowance. Do not compare absolute processed/captured counts as a nominal FPS ratio or cap processing to a camera refresh assumption.

completion_snapshot_alignment_reconfirme.fact: C, raw last_cycles and stats_last_valid/id/param/mode all update in the same successful-completion NBA branch. Stats reads them directly in core_clk before NBA; there is no extra source_release/CDC delay in this tuple. The adjacent completion consistency and two-completion no-wrap proof can use C without adding an observer-edge allowance.

CPU_checks_performed.kind: Abstract event arithmetic supporting the source induction; NOT RTL execution
CPU_checks_performed.coverage: Initial C0/1/M-2/M-1, both legal P values, wait or the legal accept/complete event, and independent dropped/no-grant toggles. Point modulo identity and exact signed interval identity passed in all cases.

wrapped_counterexample.classification: Possible wrapped last residue under the stated information limits; no-wrap unproven, so do not reject just because candidate<N.

CPU_checks_performed.limits: The arithmetic check does not simulate the capture/DDR/timing implementation or certify the v1 host code. The source-line proof above supplies the architectural assumptions.

suggested_host_validation_order: Bind exact build/native dimensions and clock, request identities, ordered snapshots and an externally attested uninterrupted healthy epoch.
For every snapshot compute P from flagbit1 and require(A-C)mod32=P. Do not fold dropped into the equation.
For every bounded interval recover modulo32 dA/dC, require dA-dC=P2-P1 with signed arithmetic, and check dC<=dt//N+1.
Keep the already source-proven completion tuple/count consistency and reject contradictory repeated tuples.

Classify each last-duration sample as proven, contradictory or unproven using since-reset and within-window bounds. Apply duration>=N only to proven durations; reject a candidate that violates an independently known upper bound instead of downgrading that contradiction to unproven.
Report processed throughput from dC/(dt/nominal_hz), and keep sparse last-frame duration samples/proofs distinct from a complete per-frame distribution.
v1_host_implementation_review: Not certified by this source-semantics review; parent owns the isolated implementation and cloud validation.
